description: Discovers carriers, fleet routes, and weekly sailings for ocean-freight forwarders; combines Weiyun's public port/carrier APIs with user-registered routePort URLs.

novel_features.name: Route registry
novel_features.description: List all registered Weiyun lane URLs (alias -> URL).

novel_features.name: Pull schedule HTML
novel_features.description: Fetch routePort HTML for one or all registered lanes and persist to local SQLite.

novel_features.name: Query lane snapshot
novel_features.description: Read the most recent scraped schedule for a registered lane from local SQLite.

novel_features.name: Soonest sailing
novel_features.description: Returns the lane's nearest future ETD vessel name + voyage + capacity + flag.

novel_features.name: Carrier comparison
novel_features.description: Group lane vessels by ETD with carrier+service context.
